synthesis: Today's work centers on XJournal AI's lyric engine at a turning point: Model G v4.1 landed yesterday with multi-bar punchlines (b93b60c), and PR #9 is sitting ready to make v5 selectable in the UI alongside per-line feedback fixes. The vigorous-bartik session left off with v5 essentially done — the first action is to review and merge PR #9 so the new model tier is testable by real sessions. Alongside that, the Dashboard X audit from the relaxed-saha session produced a clean batch of verified fixes still uncommitted in worktree branch claude/relaxed-saha-2b85c3; letting those rot risks losing the port-correction and .env.example work. After the merge, the natural next build target is the four remaining sliders (Slang density, Imply↔Explain, Rhyme hardness, Verse length) plus wiring BPM/Key/Scale metadata into the v5 prompt assembly path — closing the gap between the metadata editor that already exists and the generation path that doesn't yet consume it.
